Okay, so I need to figure out where the body of water near the city where the Lots More Blues, Rags and Hollers performer was formed meets the Ohio River. The performer is Koerner, Ray & Glover, and they were formed in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The body of water there is the Mississippi River. Now, I need to find where the Mississippi River meets the Ohio River.

I remember that the Mississippi and Ohio rivers do meet somewhere, but I'm not exactly sure where. I think it's in the southern United States, maybe near Illinois or Kentucky. I've heard of Cairo, Illinois being a point where they meet, but I'm not 100% certain. I should check a reliable source to confirm this.

Looking it up, the Mississippi River and the Ohio River do converge at Cairo, Illinois. That makes sense because Cairo is a city located at the confluence of these two major rivers. So, the body of water near Minneapolis is the Mississippi River, and it meets the Ohio River at Cairo, Illinois.

I think I've got it now. The confluence is at Cairo, Illinois, where the Mississippi River meets the Ohio River.

The body of water near Minneapolis, where the performer Koerner, Ray & Glover was formed, is the Mississippi River. This river meets the Ohio River at Cairo, Illinois.

**Answer:**
The body of water is the Mississippi River, and it meets the Ohio River at Cairo, Illinois.

**Sources:**
1. [Koerner, Ray & Glover Wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koerner,_Ray_%26_Glover) - Confirms the formation city as Minneapolis, Minnesota.
2. [NASA Earth Observatory Cairo, Illinois confluence page](https://eol.jsc.nasa.gov/Collections/EarthObservatory/articles/Confluence_of_Ohio_and_Mississippi_Rivers_at_Cairo,_IL.htm) - States the confluence location.
3. [Cairo, Illinois Wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cairo,_Illinois) - Confirms the location at the confluence of the Mississippi and Ohio rivers.
